Supreme Court Grants Bail to Two Bilkis Bano Case Convicts

The Supreme Court has granted bail to two convicts in the Bilkis Bano case, Bipinchand Kanaiyalal Joshi and Pradip Ramanlal Modhiya. The decision has raised questions regarding the suspension of their sentences. The lawyer representing the convicts challenged their conviction, stating that Bilkis Bano did not name them as accused in her initial statements to the police and the magistrate.
